title: OpenAI and kids safety group Common Sense Media partner to consolidate competing measures for a California ballot initiative meant to protect kids from chatbots (Maria Curi/Axios)
summary: Maria Curi / Axios: OpenAI and kids safety group Common Sense Media partner to consolidate competing measures for a California ballot initiative meant to protect kids from chatbots — - Common Sense Media and OpenAI had competing measures that the new Parents & Kids Safe AI Act consolidates.
